procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the seven pages are LANDSCAPE-GENUINE (raw ~2420x1870 renders read upright directly, no transpose -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/leflore/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (11/11).
structure_note: Same 7-page shape (header '2026 Leflore County Federal General Election'): p1 is the certification/signature page (five commissioners signed, date unfilled); p2+p3 = table A over the county's 18 precincts (11 columns, then Sidon/'South Gwd'/'South Itta Bena'/'Southeast Gwd'/'Southwest Gwd'/Swiftown/'West Gwd' + TOTAL); p4 = table B's first 11-column group with the LOCAL sections following it; p5 = table B's tail columns + TOTAL; p6+p7 = the remaining local rows' two column groups (declared local_only). The SEMS row-block split: 'Circuit Court 4-3-Circuit District 4-3' prints as the LAST header box on p2/p3 and Carol White Richard's row starts p4 (the Warren p5 carry pattern). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District (Ron Eller, Bennie G. Thompson, Bennie Foster -- the House 2 roster, names identical); Court Of Appeals 02-District 2 Position 1 (Deborah A. McDonald -- the CoA 2 roster, name identical); Chancery Court 7-2-Chancery District 7-2 (Willie J. Perkins Sr., W. M. Sanders -- the same Place 2 section Sunflower's portion of Chancery 7 elects, names identical); Circuit Court 4-1-Circuit District 4-1 (Richard A. Smith -- the same candidate Sunflower prints; X-celled outside its sub-district: Minter City/Money/Mvsu/Ne Gwd/North Gwd/Schlater plus Southeast Gwd/West Gwd carry values, the rest X) and Place 3 (Carol White Richard -- the same candidate Sunflower prints; Leflore prints NO Place 2 section, so the family record is Sunflower's printed union with Leflore a subset). Printed totals: Colom 6317, Hyde-Smith 1987, Pinkins 98, Eller 1973, G. Thompson 6283, Foster 142, McDonald 6541, Perkins Sr. 4124, Sanders 4006, Richard A. Smith 4030, Carol White Richard 2606.
operator_rows_note: All 11 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (seven precinct cells + printed TOTAL); Richard A. Smith's row carries cells on both table-A pages (its X-celled blanks become 0 under the row's own printed TOTAL: 2625+1405 = 4030); Carol White Richard's row carries p4 (eleven precinct cells) + p5 (seven precinct cells + printed TOTAL: 1789+817 = 2606, the established X-cell rule).
truncation_note: No truncations; the eighteen precinct headers print complete (Central Gwd, East Gwd, Minter City, Money, Morgan City, Mvsu, Ne Gwd, North Gwd, North Itta Bena, Rising Sun, Schlater, Sidon, 'South Gwd', 'South Itta Bena', 'Southeast Gwd', 'Southwest Gwd', Swiftown, 'West Gwd' -- the sheet's own ward forms kept verbatim).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 4-3: 'County Court-County Court Judge' (Kevin A. Adams, James K. Littleton, George S. Whitten, Jr.), 'Leflore County Schools Dist. 2-County School Board Member' (Kalanya Moore), 'Leflore-Tax Assessor' (Carlos C. Byrd, Samantha Milton, Antwoine Williams) -- declared local_only. Chancery 7's single printed Place 2 keeps the bare 'Chancery Court' label (matching Quitman/Coahoma's); Circuit 4's two printed Places write Place-qualified labels (matching Sunflower's).
